remarks: Enjoy Peace and Quiet in the Desirable Chesterfield Complex a beautiful neighborhood community just a short walk to shopping, gym, downtown restaurants and nightlife. This end unit townhouse has a private entrance with front porch. The Kitchen features new recessed lights, newer cabinets, countertops, stainless appliances and porcelain tile floor. The Dining Room w/engineered wood floors opens to the bright Living Room with vaulted ceiling, skylights, wood burning fireplace & sliders to your own private deck, perfect for grilling, dining and relaxing! Also on the main level is a 1/2 bath and laundry closet. Upstairs the spacious Primary Bedroom features 4 large closets plus a stunning updated Full Bath featuring a bright skylight, new vanity w/double sinks, water closet and a gorgeous spa-like walk-in shower with bench. In addition the complex includes tons of open parking right outside your front door, 2 beautiful pools and 24 hour security guard in this lush gated community. Pets at landlords discretion. Good Credit and References a Must!!
